descriptions.text: Enchanted Repeating Crossbow of the Scavenger Mother of Mothers. This is a unique item. This is a repeating, ranged weapon. It has the buffet enchantment, meaning it will not run out of basic ammunition. […] This crossbow is rumored to have been given to Nekhebit's last warrior guardian as a gift for remaining true to her faith. This item may only be wielded by a female. For every female in your party, up to thirty, this item's damage and firing speed is increased by 25 percent. […] +15 Dexterity when wielded +10 Strength when wielded Casts Birth Defect on monster types who generate or birth additional monsters.

recap.text: Carl cannot pull the crossbow off the undead Hekla's back; only Katia, who killed her, can. The escape tears the body in half and leaves the crossbow's half beyond the wall, yet it forms in Katia's hands, almost plastic to the touch. Carl touches it and the system warns him: You have a dick. Behind Katia's sentinel-gun form it fires about two bolts a second, each taking only a tiny bit of health from the tentacled former Razor Fox.

Katia's crossbow forms with an ominous click on the Scorpion's Bite, a weapon mount that has appeared on Donut's back while Huanxin Jinx stands trapped in a circle of words of power. Mordecai walks in with a plain bolt holding some of his mother's ashes in its tip, says goodbye to Katia, loads the crossbow and walks out. The bolt slams between the alien's eyes, and she slides dead to Victory's feet.

Donut swaps into the room through one of Lucia's loop-de-loop traps with the Scorpion's Bite on her back and the crossbow cocked, Katia's Bolt of Ophiotaurus loaded. She fires it straight into Emberus's smouldering eye socket, then puts a second shot, one of her ten Danforth bolts, into the other eye. His yellow invulnerability glow winks off, and for fifteen seconds he is vulnerable and cannot move.

beats.headline: Off Hekla's back
beats.text: Carl tries to pull the crossbow off the undead Hekla's back and it will not come; it has to be Katia, who killed her, and he tells her to grab the key first and then everything she can. In the escape the body is torn in half, and the half with the crossbow is left on the far side of the wall. It's too bad about that crossbow, Carl says. Oh, you mean this, says Katia, and it forms in her hands. It looks like gold, feels almost like plastic, and is inlaid with carvings of a vulture creature. The moment Carl touches it, the system warns him: You have a dick.
beats.gist: The crossbow left behind on Hekla's torn body re-forms in Katia's hands, since she killed her.

beats.headline: Two a second, not Hekla's speed
beats.text: Katia rolls into her sentinel-gun form, three spider-like legs and a flesh-coloured shield, and the crossbow appears out of her inventory and locks into place behind it, a firing slit opening like a mouth. It loads, cocks and fires itself while she holds the prod down: about two bolts a second, magical, razor-tipped, about twenty inches long, gone on their own a minute after firing. That is fast, but nowhere near as fast as it was for Hekla, and the fire and lightning on Hekla's bolts went with the rest of her gear. Against the tentacled thing that used to be a Razor Fox, each hit takes only a tiny bit of health.
beats.gist: Katia's crossbow fires itself twice a second, slower than for Hekla, and barely dents the tentacled thing.

beats.headline: On Donut's back, Mordecai's bolt
beats.text: Huanxin Jinx is trapped in a circle of words of power, and a weapon mount from the Apothecary's gold benefactor box appears on Donut's back: the Scorpion's Bite. Katia's crossbow forms on it with an ominous click, bigger than Donut and not loaded. It is not as strong as it could be, Donut says, with no women in her party. Mordecai walks into the tent holding a plain bolt with some of his mother's ashes in its tip, a funeral rite of his culture. He says goodbye to Katia, loads the bolt into the crossbow on Donut's back and walks out. The crossbow fires. The bolt slams between the alien's eyes, and she slides to Victory's feet, dead.
beats.gist: Katia's crossbow forms on Donut's back, and Mordecai's ash-tipped bolt kills the alien.

beats.headline: Into the god's eyes
beats.text: Donut swaps into the room through one of Lucia's loop-de-loop traps, the Scorpion's Bite on her back with the crossbow cocked and ready, and loaded into it is Katia's Bolt of Ophiotaurus. She aims and fires true, straight into Emberus's smouldering eye socket. A second shot takes the other eye: one of her ten Danforth bolts, made to hold the god in place. His yellow invulnerability glow winks off. For fifteen seconds Emberus is vulnerable, and he cannot move.
beats.gist: Donut's bolts hit both of Emberus's eyes, leaving him vulnerable and immobile for fifteen seconds.

relations.note: The goddess its description is named for
